coverage.name: Pueblo (city)
limitations: Participating: the commissioners approved the 2026 election IGA with the City of Pueblo on 2026-08-18.
City Resolution No. 16419 ratifies the city clerk's certification of ballot content to the county: Ballot Questions 2A and 2B only.
Excluded 2A (not housing): 0.25% sales and use tax for the Department of Fire and technology related to public safety.
Excluded 2B (not housing): citizen-initiated 0.167% sales tax for the operations and capital improvement of the Pueblo Zoo, 2027 through 2031.
The county sample ballot could not be read (HTTP 403), so the city list was not cross-checked against it.
